blocks.title: Cloud computing
blocks.text: Cloud computing internet par servers, storage aur applications jaise computing wasail tak aasan pohanch deti hai, jo kam intezami mehnat se jaldi diye aur wapas liye ja sakte hain.

Yeh internet par pohanche jane wala taqatwar computer kiraye par lene jaisa hai: apni machines khareedne aur sambhalne ki bajaye aap jitna chahein, kahin se bhi, istemal karte aur sirf istemal ki qeemat dete hain.

blocks.prompt: Apne servers khareedne ke muqable mein cloud computing ke do faide bataiye.
blocks.explanation: Hardware ki bari ibtidai laagat ya dekh bhaal nahi, aur wasail zaroorat ke saath barh ya ghat sakte hain, sirf istemal ki qeemat ke saath.

items: Cloud computing: internet par computing wasail kiraye par; istemal ki qeemat dein.
